This causes the function to miss valid outputs.

Then, as I iterate through the next input, I yield tuples pairing that frozen previous value with each new value from the current iterator. Once this second iterator is also exhausted, I freeze its last value too and continue building the pattern with whatever remains.

The solution involves collecting all exhausted iterables' final values into a pool, then for each new iterable, yielding tuples that pair those frozen values with every element from the new iterable. This continues until all iterables are processed.
